title: ChatRestrictionBypass
description: Bypasses the chat resriction by using the new PaperAPI Dialogs [ServerSide]
body:
**ChatRestrictionBypass** lets players execute commands and send messages through an elegant in-game dialog — no chat bar, no slash commands, no typing required.

Perfect for servers with chat/command restrictions, mobile/Bedrock players, or anyone who wants a smoother, more accessible command experience.

## Features

- **Gesture Trigger** — Crouch 3 times within 1.5s to open the dialog (fully configurable)
- **Two Modes** — Run server commands or send chat messages from a clean UI
- **Command History** — Quick re-run your last commands with one click
- **Permission-Aware** — Respects existing command permissions; blocks dangerous commands by default
- **Lightweight** — Built for Paper 1.21.7+ with Adventure Components & native dialogs
- **Customizable** — Full MiniMessage support for colors, gradients, and formatting

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---------|-----------|-------------|
| `/chatbypass reload` | `chatbypass.admin` | Reload configuration |
| `/chatbypass open` | `chatbypass.admin` | Open the dialog manually |

## Default Blocked Commands

`op`, `deop`, `stop`, `restart`, `reload`, `plugins`, `pl`, `version`, `ver`, `about`, `icanhasbukkit`, `bukkit`, `minecraft:*`

## Permissions

- `chatbypass.admin` — Access to `/chatbypass` commands (default: `op`)

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21.7+ (uses native `io.papermc.paper.dialog` API)
